We have filed application for registration of trademark under class 9 for “Vault Daudegi Zindagi” vide application number 5559018 dated August 05, 2022 which has been objected by Registrar of Trademarks under section 9(1)(b) of Trade Mark Act, 1999.
Furthermore, Our Company has filed its reply against the said objection on January 24, 2023 & the matter is pending before Registrar of Trademark as on date.
